page.layout: One table fragment, left part of a page: a column of Cap. numbers at top, a rule, then a word column (Vocum) with Hebrew words, a second rule, and Greek words below.; One page of index in three parts: a title across the top; below it, a table of Vers. / Pag. with a Cap. column to the right of a vertical rule; then a ruled section headed "Hebr. & Graecarum" with Hebrew and Greek words at right; then a ruled section of Greek entries; a knotwork woodcut ornament at the lower left. Left and right of the scan are cut off.; One narrow strip of a page: at the top a column of short bold lines and headings; in the middle a horizontal rule with "Ibidem" and two lines of figures to the right; below a second rule with two lines of Greek words and figures; at the bottom a woodcut ornament. No margin notes.; One page of a table, printed in two columns of lines at the right of the scan: a table of Vers. and Pag. columns with a ruled heading "illustratarum" between rules. No margins with text.
page.notes: The Greek third word is only partly legible; the Hebrew and Greek letters are set in heavy type. The left margin carries only specks and scan marks, which are not transcribed. The right and left edges of the scan are cut off, so most entries end mid-word or are missing; the Cap. column and the Hebrew and Greek words are truncated at the right edge. The title "I N D E" is cut after the E. The lower part of the page is a knotwork woodcut ornament, not text. Scattered specks and a stray dash are not printed text. Fragmentary strip: only the right-hand ends of lines survive, so most words are cut off. The Greek words are partly illegible; the readings are approximate. The woodcut at the bottom is a knotwork ornament and is not transcribed as text. The fragment shows only the right-hand portions of lines; the left parts of the lines are cut off. Partial lines are transcribed as they appear. The word "illustratarum" is set between two ruled lines. Some letters at line starts are missing from the scan.
